card.name: Words about a relationship between two parties
card.fires_on: Words that refer to something shared or happening between two people or sides, such as their affair, bilateral trade, a secret meeting, or conflict. It fires in general web prose about relationships and partnerships, and occasionally in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Shared between two parties
modes.description: Words like their or bilateral that point to something belonging to or passing between two people or countries.

modes.description: Words about people meeting, clashing or forming a partnership.

modes.label: Used together
modes.description: The word together in the context of using two drugs at once.

card.writes: It seems to promote words meaning mutual, bilateral, agreed or confrontation, which favors language about relations between two parties.
card.plain: It lights up on words that describe something happening between two people or sides, like a shared affair, trade between two countries, or a conflict.
